# nagios_authserver (Data Source)

Reads an existing Nagios XI authentication server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nagios_authserver" "example" {
  server_id = "1"
}

output "authserver_connection_method" {
  value = data.nagios_authserver.example.connection_method
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) The ID of the authentication server

### Read-Only

- `ad_account_suffix` (String) The account suffix used when the connection method is 'ad'
- `ad_domain_controllers` (String) A comma separated list of domain controllers used for Active Directory authentication
- `base_dn` (String) The Base DN where the user accounts exist in AD or LDAP that will be authenticating to Nagios
- `connection_method` (String) The connection method used for authentication. This value can be either 'ad' or 'ldap'
- `enabled` (Boolean) Determines whether or not this authentication server is enabled
- `ldap_host` (String) The LDAP host name or IP address connected to
- `ldap_port` (String) The TCP port used when connecting with LDAP
- `security_level` (String) The security level used to encrypt the connection. It can be either 'none', 'ssl' or 'tls'
